## Data Source

Historical NFL injury reports from the nflverse project,
accessed using the nflreadr R package.

## Import Data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(nflreadr)
library(dplyr)

injuries <- load_injuries(seasons = 2024)
```

## Examine Dataset

The 2024 NFL injury dataset contains 6,215 observations
and 16 variables.

```{r}
#| echo: true

glimpse(injuries)
```
